data_fields.name: max logic steps per frame (proposed, not donor)
data_fields.donor_constant: donor runs at most one step per pass; sketch uses 5 as a proposed cap to be tested on a phone

best_idea: Run the game logic on its own fixed step with carried time (an accumulator), separate from the render loop that paces frames, and move the view by real frame time instead of a fixed amount per frame.
decision_why: The fixed logic step decoupled from render and a float frame cap transfer; the donor drops carried time, uses integer milliseconds and moves the view by an integer per frame, so each is fixed in the sketch. The step itself is the duel sim (row 1); the loop that drives it is client-only.
acceptance: A test drives the loop at 50 fps (20 ms frames) for 10 s and counts 150 +/- 1 sim steps (15 per second), not 125; a scroll test at a 240 Hz refresh gives 300 px/s +/- 1 percent at speed 10, not 240.
